meta.name: CCNL per il personale dipendente non dirigente delle imprese di assicurazione (ANIA)

notes.text: Covers personale amministrativo assunto dal 18/12/1999 (Allegato 2/B — tabella omnicomprensiva). Pre-1999 hires (Allegato 2/A) are out of scope.

limitation.remediation: Model Allegato 2/A for the staff hired before 18/12/1999, gated on the hire date, or open a limitation.

notes.text: First tranche decorrenza 01/01/2026 is retroactive; CCNL signed 13/05/2026. Arretrati January–July 2026 paid in July 2026 (Allegato 7). Period start is 2026-01-01 in the engine.
Additional months = 14 (tredicesima + quattordicesima). Monthly amounts are 1/14 of annual retribuzione. Source: Allegato 2/B header, FirstCISL PDF rinnovo 13/05/2026.
Seniority: cl 1 = anni 1-4 (48 months, quadriennale); cl 2 onward = 3 years each (36 months, triennale). Source: Art. 113 CCNL + Allegato 2/B class table.
L7 maximum seniority class is CL08 (anni 23-25); L1-L6 reach CL12 (oltre 34 anni). maximum_count_by_level overrides L7 to 7 advances.
Hourly divisor 160 (37h/week). Source: ilccnl.it, confirmed from Art. orario di lavoro CCNL ANIA.
Seniority increment amounts vary across tranches (e.g. L4: 67.51 → 70.17 → 72.30). Represented exactly via TimeSeries in amount_by_level.

Indennità economica funzionari (Allegato 2/D) — L7 only, six sub-grade variants (Ex 3°/2°/1° Grado, Funz. Senior, Funz. Business, Ass. ex F2) with distinct amounts. Monthly amounts not found in publicly accessible sources (Allegato 2/D not published). Not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model Allegato 2/D: the indennità economica of the six L7 funzionari sub-grades as role-keyed fixed_allowances on L7 (like IND_PROFILO_J), once the amounts are sourced.

notes.text: Indennità profilo J) 4° livello (Allegato 2/E) — modelled as fixed_allowance IND_PROFILO_J on L4 with role 'profilo_j'. Amounts: €57.26/mese dal 01/01/2026, €59.51 dal 01/01/2027, €61.32 dal 01/01/2028. Set Employment.roles=profilo_j to include it (review of 2026-10-30).

Indennità economica 6° livello quadro (Allegato 2/F) — modelled as fixed_allowance IND_QUADRO_6 on L6 with role 'quadro_6'. Amount: €74.09/mese dal 01/01/2026. Set Employment.roles=quadro_6 to include it (review of 2026-10-30).
Seniority increment = modal per-class difference in the 1/14 monthly table (Allegato 2/B); classes above CL01 may differ from the official table by ±0.02. Source: Allegato 2/B, Rinnovo 13/05/2026.

limitation.remediation: Replace the modal per-class difference with the official Allegato 2/B amounts per class.

notes.text: INPS employer_rate 26.76% flat from kitech.it (Credito e Assicurazioni 2026); reuses 2026-credito.json. Verify against the annual INPS circular.

limitation.remediation: Resolved as a duplicate of assicurazioni-ania/inps_sector_rates_unsourced, which stays open (review of 2026-10-30): both say the credito employer rate is not confirmed by a 2026 INPS source. contribution/2026/credito.json now takes 26.76 from the INPS 2012 table and keeps the Fondo di solidarietà out of the totals, in parameters.solidarity_fund.

notes.text: Salary tables: FirstCISL Gruppo Unipol, Allegato 2/B — Tabella omnicomprensiva post-1999, decorrenza 01/01/2026, 01/01/2027, 01/01/2028.
Apprenticeship: Art. 5, Allegato 18 (Accordo apprendistato professionalizzante), CCNL testo 2017/2018, confirmed applicable post-rinnovo 2026.
Class cadence: Art. 113 CCNL + column 'Anni serv.' Allegato 2/B.

INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: SOLIDARITY FUND: Fondo di solidarietà del settore assicurativo (accord ANIA of 20 May 2013, D.I. 78459 of 17 January 2014): ordinary contribution 0.30% of the INPS taxable pay of permanent workers, 0.20% employer and 0.10% worker, dirigenti excluded (INPS circ. 56/2015 p. 11); collected by INPS in the overall rate.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

source_document.title: INPS Circolare n. 56 del 10 marzo 2015, Fondo di solidarietà del settore assicurativo (D.I. 78459/2014)

location.quote: dovuto al Fondo un contributo ordinario dello 0,30% (di cui lo 0,20% a carico del datore di lavoro e lo 0,10% a carico dei lavoratori) calcolato sulla retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali di tutti i lavoratori dipendenti con contratto a tempo indeterminato, esclusi i dirigenti.

provenance.transformation: 0.20% employer and 0.10% worker of the INPS taxable pay of every permanent worker; the CCNL ANIA has no dirigenti level.
provenance.note: The circular is of 2015: no 2026 source found confirms the rate, nor whether the fund changed it when funds adapted to D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 26 c. 7-bis.

location.section: Malattia — piena retribuzione; conservazione posto 12 mesi (<10 anni anzianita')

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: art. 113 (p. 81) and Allegato 18 cap. 3 artt. 5, 8 and 9 (pp. 250, 253, OCR) of the CCNL of 22 February 2017.
findings: The apprentice is classified up to two levels below, then one; the period 'è computato integralmente nella maturazione dell'anzianità e degli automatismi' (art. 8), the general CCNL applies to what the accordo does not settle (art. 9) and art. 113 counts the seniority of the scatto from the hire month: the increments of the level the apprentice is paid at.

reviews.scope: Monthly values on scanned pages, each read twice from the page image by two independent sessions of another model, the second without being told the expected value.
findings: 24 values read identically by both readings and equal to the file.
